name: power-presentation
description: /present — wow-effect product presentation videos for marketing, sales and investors on top of HyperFrames: prod-first capture, non-UI products (CLI/API/SDK/data/mocks/docs), 14 QA gates, English only.

model_mix.title: Model mix
model_mix.description: Which models run the pipeline: economy (Sonnet everywhere, no critic panel, at most 2 agents at a time — for smaller subscriptions; a run that stops at a usage limit continues on the next /present), all-sonnet (~$15/run), opus-orchestrator (Opus story director + Sonnet workers, ~$22, default), all-opus (~$36).

critic.title: Vision critic panel
critic.description: The 3-vote vision critic at the end of a run (~15 agents): auto = on, off in the economy profile; on; off. The --critic / --no-critic flags override it per run.

privacy.title: Privacy profile
privacy.description: default, or local = the local privacy profile (no telemetry, no cloud TTS/render/vision, network manifest printed before the first external call). The --privacy local flag overrides per run.

budget_usd.title: Token budget per run (USD)
budget_usd.description: Hard ceiling for one /present run in the default model mix (target: $25). The estimate is printed before dispatch; a second critic round is only taken when budget remains.

brand_kit_dir.title: Brand kit directory
brand_kit_dir.description: Default --brand <dir>: brand.tokens.json (DTCG) + brand.md + logo light/dark SVG + fonts with licence class.

heygen_api_key.title: HeyGen API key (optional)
heygen_api_key.description: Enables HeyGen cloud voice/BGM/render paths in HyperFrames. Never used under privacy=local.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Premium multilingual TTS. Off by default; price shown before use. Never used under privacy=local.
